message: export-evals --out on an all-unvalued ledger still writes an empty output file before exiting 3; a later reader that ignores the exit code could take that file as $0. Skip the write when exiting 3.

Two github-advanced-security S4036 review threads from dc145bfb are still unresolved although the code is fixed and Sonar shows 0 vulnerabilities at this head; resolve them.
10 open Sonar code smells (S3776 cognitive complexity in main and usageToLedger, S3358 nested ternaries); gate is OK.
